# BMA DXS answers for tests (synthetic)

Made by hand from the element names and types of the public WSDL (`https://dxg-api.dds.bangkok.go.th/WSS_DDSDXS.asmx?WSDL`, read 2026-09-26). Station codes, names, places and readings are invented; they are not DXS data. They cover a missing value, a swapped coordinate, an empty coordinate, a Buddhist-era year, an offset-less time (Thai time) and an out-of-range level. `getFloodingDailyReport.xml` has one road still flooded (dry time 00:00), one dry again and one from the evening before written with Buddhist-era dates and a dotted time; road names are invented. As in the real answer of 2026-09-26, a road still flooded has FloodFinishDate 0000-00-00 and FloodFinishTime ":", and LastUpdate is UTC without an offset.
